description: Example configuration for Homebridge Notify Alerts

webhooks._comment: Basic notification to a single device
webhooks.name: Front Door Motion
webhooks.text: Motion detected at the front door!

webhooks._comment: Notification with a title, a sender icon and a hero image
webhooks.name: Garage Door Alert
webhooks.text: The garage door has been opened
webhooks.title: Garage Alert

webhooks._comment: Group notification. Group IDs are GRP plus 5 characters, and have their own token, separate from any device token.
webhooks.name: Security Alert
webhooks.title: SECURITY ALERT

webhooks._comment: Time sensitive alert. Breaks through Focus and Do Not Disturb, so reserve it for real emergencies.
webhooks.name: Water Leak
webhooks.text: Water detected under the kitchen sink
webhooks.title: Leak Detected

webhooks._comment: Threading. These two share a thread ID, so they collapse into one thread instead of stacking up.
webhooks.name: Bedtime Reminder
webhooks.text: It's 10 PM, time to get ready for bed
webhooks.title: Bedtime

webhooks._comment: Web device. Browser IDs start with WB and work on every endpoint just like a phone.
webhooks.name: Desk Browser Ping
